tools.name: app_reconcile_workspace_with_cloud
tools.description: Reconcile a Workspace using three content fingerprints: live local L, last confirmed synchronized baseline B, and APS current snapshot R. L=R is in_sync; L=B and R differs restores the cloud version; R=B and L differs returns local_ahead and preserves/uploads local work; only a true L/B/R divergence saves a local copy then force-restores cloud. When B or R is unavailable, baseline_missing keeps local files unchanged. An empty local Workspace is restored from cloud. A semantic_validation_failed marker also keeps local files unchanged.

Remaining cloud-only cards are deferred until opened; an opened Workspace is promoted ahead of automatic work. Restore and preview rebuild are independently queued at single concurrency. Workspaces already present locally and locally tombstoned deletions are skipped.
